svg.aria-label: A table of 7 rows, start and steps 1 to 6, and 4 columns, ranks 0 to 3, each with 4 chunks c0 to c3. At the start rank r holds r + 1 in every chunk. In step 1 rank 1's c0 becomes 3, rank 2's c1 5, rank 3's c2 7 and rank 0's c3 5. After step 3 rank 0 holds 10 in c1, rank 1 in c2, rank 2 in c3 and rank 3 in c0. Steps 4 to 6 copy each 10 around the ring until every chunk of every rank is 10.
svg.text: 4 ranks, 4 chunks: the values the program prints after each step.
Rank r starts with r + 1 in all 4 chunks. In step s of reduce-scatter, rank r sends chunk
(r − s) mod 4 to rank r + 1, which adds it. After 3 steps each rank holds 1 complete
chunk; 3 steps of all-gather pass the complete chunks on, overwriting.
